transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I came in because I've been trying to turn my art into a freelance business lately. But... I just keep getting really wound up over things like invoices and client messages. I end up avoiding them until I'm just sitting at my kitchen table crying, or... I forget normal things, like paying my own bills.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge when you're not working on your art, but instead focusing on the business side of things?
I mean... maybe? I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... I don't know, I just avoid doing it.
Do you feel anxious when you're dealing with the business side of your art?
I guess so. I don't really know if I'd call it that. I just... I don't like looking at that stuff, so I put it off.
Do you find yourself avoiding things more often than you used to?

Yeah... I guess. It's starting to affect things. Like... my freelance work, and just stuff around the house. I put off a client reply recently... and I missed a utility payment. I was just trying to keep up with an art display I'm doing, so... I don't know. I just didn't deal with the other stuff.
Was there something specific that happened around the time you started feeling this way about the business side of your art?

Um... I guess so. I took on a community arts contract recently. And I was trying to make the business side more... formal, I guess. I think it was about a month after that when I started getting so overwhelmed by it all and... just avoiding it.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
No... not that I've noticed. Everything is pretty much the same there, I guess.
Do you find yourself having repetitive thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
Um... no, not really. Just the usual, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
No... I haven't had anything like that. Just normal stress, I suppose.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when they are going well?
I don't think so. If things are fine, they're fine. I don't really... look for things to worry about, I guess.
Has your avoidance of business-related tasks affected your relationships with friends, family, or clients?

Um... I guess a little. It's mostly just... my freelance work. I did put off replying to a client recently. And... I suppose some home things, too. I actually missed a utility payment the other day. I've just been trying to keep up with this art display, so... yeah. That's about it.
Have you noticed any significant problems in your relationships or daily life because of avoiding business-related tasks or other things?

I think I just said that... um, yeah. It's mostly the freelance stuff. Like I said, I put off that client reply. And I missed that utility bill. I'm just... really focused on the art display right now.
Is avoiding business-related tasks the only thing you've been avoiding, or have you found yourself avoiding other things as well?
Um... no, not really. Just what I already told you. I don't think there's anything else.
Is avoiding business-related tasks something that you think you would still be doing if you didn't have the community arts contract?

I don't know... maybe? It's hard to say. The contract is still going on, and all the changes with the business side of things are still happening. So... I haven't really had a time where the stress of it all has been over, you know? Not for a while. So I can't really tell you what I'd be doing if it wasn't there.
Do you think you would avoid business-related tasks if you didn't have any upcoming deadlines or contracts?

I mean... I think I just answered that. The contract is still happening. The whole business side of things is still changing. I haven't really had a stretch of time where all this stress has just... stopped. So I don't know what I'd do without it.
Do you think you would avoid tasks other than business-related ones if they felt similarly overwhelming or stressful to you?
I don't know... I mean, I guess I can't really say. I haven't really thought about it like that.
Do you avoid tasks outside of business and art as well when you find them stressful?
I don't... I don't really know. I haven't really noticed doing that with other things. Just the business stuff mostly.
Do you avoid tasks outside of business and art when you find them difficult or stressful?
I... I mean, I think I just said that. I haven't really noticed it with anything else. Just the business stuff.
Do you think you would avoid other tasks, not just business-related ones, if you found them similarly stressful?
I... I really don't know how else to answer that. I can't really guess what I would do in some hypothetical situation. Like I keep saying, it's just the business things right now.
Do you avoid other tasks in your life when you find them stressful?
I... I don't really have a different answer for you. We just went over this. It's only the business stuff.
